messages:
Elena: quick personal share — Alex and I are getting married! :tada: We’re having a tiny backyard ceremony on Sat Jun 14 and I’d love to do a short office celebration on Fri Jun 13 around 3pm. Nothing fancy, just snacks + a 10-min toast. Also FYI: Alex is allergic to tree nuts.
Sam: AH CONGRATS!!! :heart_eyes: so happy for you both. I can bring a savory thing.
Rachael: congrats elena!! :tada: i’ll bring a cake (can do nut-free). what time should i drop it off?
Elena: amazing, rachael — thank you! Drop by the kitchen at 2:45 and we’ll do the toast at 3.
Noor: congrats!! can we do something simple like mixed fruit + chips? i’ll bring the fruit.
Maya: sending confetti GIF :confetti_ball: — i can help with set-up/decor at 2pm. also happy to wrangle photos if you want them.
Elena: would love photos, but trying to keep it low-key — if people want to take snaps that’s fine.
People Ops: heads-up from People Ops: small desk gatherings are ok but please keep food labeled (allergens) and avoid open flames. If you'd like a communal card, we can order one and a simple bouquet. ping @People Ops to confirm order by Wednesday.
Elena: thanks! People Ops — could you order a card? i’ll pass along a line for the card.
Sam: quick q — should we mark heads-down time exceptions for Fri 3–3:30 so folks know?
Elena: good call. i’ll ask managers and add a calendar invite.
Rachael: signed up for cake (nut-free). also can do gluten-free if helpful.
Noor: fruit platter — +1 for gluten-free option.
Maya: i’ll bring string lights and some paper plates. :thumbsup:
Sam: here’s a quick signup for extras — copy/paste into calendar description if helpful:
```
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xY_example_signups
Item | Person | Notes
Cake | Rachael | nut-free
Fruit | Noor | sliced
Savory | Sam | vegetarian
Plates | Maya | compostable
Card | People Ops | order by Wed
```
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Elena & Alex — quick office toast" Fri Jun 13 15:00–15:30 (conference kitchen). Invite sent to #all.
Elena: thank you all — feeling very loved. if you want to leave a short note for the card, DM me or drop it in the spreadsheet. see you Friday! :heart:
